author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell initially suspects a self help book on Mister Rogers is trying to secularize something fundamentally Christian, until Laura points out the author is actually a Christian counselor herself, prompting Russell to fully reverse his take on the spot. The conversation lands on something striking, that Mister Rogers deliberately smuggled the message of Christ into children's television, standing at what Russell calls the gates of hell where every other god competes for attention. A genuinely thoughtful moment about faith hiding in plain sight, and Russell owning being wrong in real time.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell talks with podcaster Ryan Miller about the chaos that hit his family after he had the former head of the Church of Satan on his show, sleepless nights, sudden illness, and snakes appearing on his walks. Ryan discovers his podcast was being cursed on satanic message boards across South Africa and America, and learns to fight what he calls a spiritual fog for two straight months. The attack breaks within five minutes of posting a single prayer request online. A raw look at spiritual warfare from someone who never expected to be in one.
